name: get_plugin_capabilities
description: Fetch an installed plugin's usage guidance (prompt) and the tools it declares, for a plugin from list_installed_plugins that might cover something no existing tool handles. A plugin you just returned an install/buy link for is not installed yet -- it only becomes usable once it appears in list_installed_plugins. Read the returned prompt and tools, then call call_plugin with the tool you decided to use.

plugin_id.description: The plugin's `plugin_id`, exactly as returned by list_installed_plugins -- never guessed.
